description: This file contains implementation and stub functions for MKL (Intel Math Kernel Library) optimized linear algebra operations within the ATen native library of PyTorch. It provides functions for batched general matrix multiplication (GEMM) with different data types, with conditional compilation depending on whether MKL is enabled.
